admission.justification: Fixed-part and location fit are proved by the named passing guard case; as a single-file member it rides the family guarantee.

applicability: Every short form built for an over-bound answer.
conditions: The fixed part precedes location/error fitting.
A valid code and any build-currentness reading remain whole.
Recorded location and cut hint take priority over optional scalar/error content.
exclusions: Under-bound answers carry no generic overflow short form.
No recorded whole-result file means an honest no-file cut hint and resultKept false; no path is invented.
The retained recorded path and final hint may exceed the 400-token target after other droppable content is removed.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_tool_answer_table.py::ToolAnswerGuardTests (passing in the R6 run); short_form fixed-part measurement unchanged

statement: The fixed short part keeps ok/code/overflow/answerTokens and any buildCurrentness, and retains the running-operation sentence within its 200-character string limit. An exact recorded-result location is kept without the former 250-token fit test, and the final cut hint names that file; optional scalars and error text make room against the 400-token target, while the recorded path and its hint remain even above it after other droppable content is removed.
